exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Downgrade Attack
exploitedBy.relevance: Weak TLS protocol versions enable downgrade attacks where an adversary forces use of older, weaker protocol versions.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Weaken Encryption
exploitedBy.relevance: Using weak TLS protocol versions directly weakens the encryption protecting the channel.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Reduce Key Space
exploitedBy.relevance: Insufficient cipher suite strength reduces the effective key space, making brute-force or cryptanalytic attacks feasible.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Encrypted Channel
exploitedBy.relevance: Missing mutual TLS authentication means only one side is verified, undermining the trust model of encrypted channels.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Asymmetric Cryptography
exploitedBy.relevance: Mutual TLS relies on asymmetric cryptography for certificate-based authentication; its absence allows impersonation attacks.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Install Root Certificate
exploitedBy.relevance: Bypassing certificate validation can be achieved by installing rogue root certificates to intercept encrypted traffic.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Steal or Forge Authentication Certificates
exploitedBy.relevance: Certificate validation bypass enables or results from forged certificates used to impersonate legitimate endpoints.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Digital Certificates
exploitedBy.relevance: Adversaries may develop or use fraudulent digital certificates when certificate validation is bypassed.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Steal or Forge Kerberos Tickets
exploitedBy.relevance: Session replay attacks share the same conceptual model as ticket/credential replay, reusing captured session tokens to authenticate.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Private Keys
exploitedBy.relevance: Without forward secrecy, compromise of a private key allows decryption of all past recorded sessions.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Service Exhaustion Flood
exploitedBy.relevance: Without rate limiting, encrypted channels are susceptible to service exhaustion floods that overwhelm server resources.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Protocol Tunneling
exploitedBy.relevance: Lack of rate limiting on encrypted channels can be exploited for high-volume tunneling of malicious traffic.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Network Boundary Bridging
exploitedBy.relevance: BGP route hijacking allows adversaries to bridge network boundaries by redirecting traffic through attacker-controlled infrastructure.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Multi-hop Proxy
exploitedBy.relevance: BGP hijacking can redirect traffic through adversary-controlled nodes, effectively functioning as a multi-hop interception proxy.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: DNS
exploitedBy.relevance: DNS-based traffic interception exploits the DNS protocol to redirect or intercept communications.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: DNS Server
exploitedBy.relevance: Adversaries compromise DNS servers to perform traffic interception by poisoning DNS responses.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Domain Fronting
exploitedBy.relevance: Domain fronting abuses DNS and CDN infrastructure to disguise and intercept traffic.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Adversary-in-the-Middle
exploitedBy.relevance: Insecure TLS renegotiation can be exploited by an adversary-in-the-middle to inject malicious data into established sessions.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Network Sniffing
exploitedBy.relevance: Insecure renegotiation vulnerabilities may expose session data to network sniffing during the renegotiation handshake.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Data Obfuscation
exploitedBy.relevance: Timing side-channels leak metadata about obfuscated communications, undermining data obfuscation protections.
